title: 棱角低位圆边
description: 水彩描绘圆润外棱旁的低位攀爬，墙面两侧和软垫完整可见。

art_direction.medium: clean cel-shaded sports animation with crisp anatomy and soft environmental light
art_direction.scene: Create an original watercolor illustration of a fictional fully clothed adult climbing beside a broad rounded arete at the base of an indoor bouldering wall. Large blue handholds sit on both adjacent faces, and positive low footholds support a comfortable stance around the edge. The climber keeps one hand on a rounded hold near the arete and reaches a short distance onto the other face. Use an oblique wide camera that reveals both wall planes, the whole adult, and continuous thick crash mats. Pale peach washes, mint shadows, and soft gym windows establish a peaceful original scene. Avoid high exposure, leaps, lettering, logos, and extreme body twists.
